confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied reference cities; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Accommodation anchors vary most by district and date and carry the widest uncertainty. Cocktail (about 2x the beer anchor) and wine (about 1.7x) are set from the local beer relationship because direct Lima price knowledge for them is weak. The FX rate comes from search-result summaries that point to the RBA exchange-rates page; it was not re-verified on the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lima is not in the supplied set. Anchors were placed mainly between the Bogota (lower) and Santiago (higher) reference points, with Buenos Aires as a higher-cost reference. The inexpensive-meal anchor sits just under Bogota.
